subject: Fiscal Year 2019 Budget Approval
overview: The committee approved the fiscal year 2019 school budget following a public hearing and presentations on final adjustments. The body also accepted a $50,000 grant for Italian language programs and referred the issue of unfunded homeless student transportation mandates to legal counsel.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes of May 21 and June 4, 2018, as well as bills, payrolls, and fund transfers.

items.title: Italian Language Grant Presentation
items.summary: Accepted a $50,000 grant from CASIT to support Italian language and culture instruction in the elementary grades.

items.title: Homeless Student Transportation Mandate
items.summary: Referred the issue of high costs associated with mandated transportation for homeless students to the City Solicitor and legal counsel to explore legislative advocacy or legal recourse regarding unfunded mandates.

items.title: FY19 Budget Public Hearing and Approval
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2019 appropriated budget of $58,608,631 and the total superintendent's budget of $60,629,011. Discussion centered on the trade-offs between operating and capital funding, security personnel hiring, and the ongoing need for additional kindergarten aides.

items.title: 2018-2019 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the school committee meeting schedule for the 2018-2019 school year.

items.title: University Partnership Report
items.summary: Received a report regarding a partnership with Lesley College for educational collaboration.
